title.zh: Galaxy Adds $100 Million of sUSDS to Treasury, Approves It as Loan Collateral
title.en: Galaxy Adds $100 Million of sUSDS to Treasury, Approves It as Loan Collateral

current_state.zh: Galaxy Digital added $100 million of Sky's sUSDS to its treasury and approved the yield-bearing stablecoin as collateral for its institutional lending clients, who can still earn Sky's 3.6% savings rate while pledging it.
current_state.en: Galaxy Digital added $100 million of Sky's sUSDS to its treasury and approved the yield-bearing stablecoin as collateral for its institutional lending clients, who can still earn Sky's 3.6% savings rate while pledging it.
